policy: reference-and-select; never auto-install from this catalog

select_when: repeatable procedure is missing
project knowledge should be reusable across agents
avoid_when: one-off instruction is sufficient

select_when: the host lacks required external read/write capability
avoid_when: native host tool already provides the capability
a local script/library is simpler

select_when: independent agent systems must communicate across framework boundaries
avoid_when: all workers are local subagents inside one host

select_when: required capability exists but provider is unknown
the environment supports an ARD-compatible discovery service
avoid_when: a trusted provider is already available
discovery would add no decision value
providers.status_note: draft/evolving; adapters must tolerate schema evolution

select_when: the developer's existing AI IDE can satisfy the task
avoid_when: required durability, interoperability, or governance is unavailable

select_when: idea-to-build or feature-change benefits from durable intent/specification artifacts
a supported Spec Kit workflow or extension closes a proven route capability gap
avoid_when: the task is a tiny local edit
the project already has an equally trustworthy specification workflow
community extensions have not passed provenance and permission review
providers.status_note: core project is mature and agent-agnostic; community extensions are independently maintained and must be reviewed before use

select_when: browser-visible behavior requires deterministic verification
UI/network/storage behavior cannot be proven adequately through static tests
avoid_when: the change has no browser surface
existing project browser tests already prove the outcome
providers.status_note: choose Test, CLI+Skills, or MCP by workload; upstream currently recommends CLI+Skills for many coding-agent workflows and MCP for persistent introspective browser loops

select_when: a well-defined reproducible software issue should be delegated to a dedicated minimal SWE agent
a clean isolated issue-solving runtime is preferable to the current host
avoid_when: product intent is ambiguous
the repository first needs recovery
the issue cannot be meaningfully verified
providers.status_note: SWE-agent maintainers currently recommend mini-SWE-agent over the older SWE-agent for new usage

select_when: a dedicated autonomous software-engineering runtime is itself the missing capability
execution isolation or a reusable coding-agent SDK is required
avoid_when: the current AI IDE already executes the route reliably
adding another general coding runtime would only duplicate host capability

select_when: dedicated long-running harness materially improves reliability
subagent context isolation is important
skills and MCP need a unified runtime
avoid_when: host-native execution is already sufficient

select_when: production workflow composition and hosting are first-class requirements
typed explicit workflows are preferable
avoid_when: the task is repository-local and short-lived

select_when: dynamic worker composition is genuinely useful
avoid_when: a single host agent or fixed subagents are sufficient

select_when: the user explicitly benefits from generating/testing new agents, tools, or workflows
avoid_when: existing skills/tools/agents already satisfy the capability
the project only needs orchestration policy

select_when: multiple humans/agents need durable shared work and governance
cross-runtime routing and approval history are required
avoid_when: solo/local work does not require organizational control-plane infrastructure
